The '''Northern Dune Sea''' was a segment of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] was located at its edge on the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]], and the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] was located within it. Other features included the [[Mushroom Mesa/Legends|Mushroom Mesa]], [[Bantha Plains/Legends|Bantha Plains]], and [[B'omarr Flats/Legends|B'omarr Flats]].<ref name="ITWoSWT" />

==History==
[[File:Northern_Dune_Sea.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in the Northern Dune Sea during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]]

The Northern Dune Sea was the location of the Great Pit of Carkoon,<ref name="ITWoSWT" /> where took place the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RotJ" /> Soon after that battle, [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]], the leader of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], arranged a [[Bombing of the Dune Sea|bombing run]] on the area around the Great Pit of Carkoon to ensure the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' incorrectly places Jabba's Palace and the Great Pit of Carkoon in the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>
